A1.justification: Both complete 25-page PDFs describe the same work and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–L. Content can be matched reliably across layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original MNIST and CIFAR-10 experiments on model fusion, fine-tuning, and pruning, plus runtime measurements and neuron-similarity analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and analyses in Section 3 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Appendix E.1 corrects the stated ResNet fusion procedure: independently computed intermediate kernels extend through layer l_r instead of l_r−1. This is a limited correction to the documented procedure; the overall partial-OT and generalized-pruning constructions remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MNIST and CIFAR-10 coverage, including heterogeneous and homogeneous training settings, limited-data fine-tuning, and single-model pruning. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including the capacity baselines in Table 3 and ZipIt comparison in Figure 15. PLeaS is newly discussed as related work but is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 3.2 changes the fine-tuning specification from zero blocks being 'not frozen' to being 'frozen,' consistent with preserving the nonzero parameter count. This revises a stated experimental control; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The layer-freezing, model-width, alternative-training-regime, clustering-algorithm, interpolation-factor, and neuron-similarity analyses are retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: Reporting practices are unchanged: five-seed averages for fusion experiments, ten-seed averages and an approximately 2% standard deviation in Figure 14, and medians of 5000 timing runs in Table 6.

E6.justification: The tables and empirical plots retain their numerical entries, curves, rankings, and reported findings. No new or revised results accompany the technical corrections.

T1.justification: The transport and clustering objectives, fusion matrices, and mathematical derivations in Appendices D, G, and H remain unchanged. The ResNet indexing correction concerns the procedural assignment of kernels.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about interpolation between weight aggregation and ensembles, generalized pruning, and size–accuracy tradeoffs. The PLeaS discussion refines research positioning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of fusion performance, neuron similarity, and pruning tradeoffs are unchanged. The limitations concerning small architectures, standard benchmarks, computational costs, and choosing interpolation factors are also retained.

D1.justification: The frozen-zero-block statement in Section 3.2 and intermediate-kernel range in Appendix E.1 correct implementation documentation. Other hyperparameters, hardware information, and code-access information remain unchanged; implementation changes are not independently established.

R1.justification: v2 adds Nasery et al. (2025) and a paragraph acknowledging PLeaS's related partial-matching approach. It distinguishes partial OT and weight interpolation from permutation matching with least-squares refitting and relates both approaches to generalized pruning.

P1.justification: v2 adds the PLeaS paragraph, removes a short explanation of the neuron counts in Figure 2, and makes localized technical corrections. The section organization and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves from page 3 to page 4, and Figure 9 moves between columns on page 9, with accompanying text and table reflow. Figure contents, captions, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves attribution through the PLeaS comparison and corrects the contradictory fine-tuning statement and incomplete ResNet kernel range. These changes improve technical clarity and reproducibility while leaving the empirical evidence and principal conclusions unchanged.
